collection.name: Suwappu Membership
collection.tagline: The NFT IS the subscription. One soulbound membership per wallet, resolving your tier for the bot.
collection.compliance: Soulbound membership credential. It records which Suwappu service tier a wallet currently holds. It is NOT equity, NOT a security, NOT a derivative or investment of any kind, confers no shareholder, voting or ownership rights, pays nothing out, cannot be bought or sold, and gives no economic exposure to Suwappu or to any other issuer. It is access, not an asset.

tiers._comment: Order MUST match the Tier enum in contracts/SuwappuMembership.sol (Free=0, Pro=1, Premium=2, Enterprise=3). `accent` is the tier's INK, given as a literal hex rather than a brand-token key, because the point of this set is a property no single token carries: the four inks are tuned to a 7.14-7.84:1 contrast band on the shared #faf8f4 ground so that NO TIER IS LOUDER, DARKER OR RICHER THAN ANOTHER. Colour is a fixed IDENTITY per tier -- colour-coding, the way a real club distinguishes cards -- and explicitly NOT a rarity signal. The previous mapping failed this quietly: Free got the weakest grey (text-2) and Enterprise got pure black (text), which is a rarity ramp wearing a colour-coding costume. Every tier now gets the SAME card on the SAME cream ground; only the ink changes. Ornament is reserved for what is EARNED, which is unbroken time held.

Free.ink_note: Warm slate. Brand text-2 (#6b6560) taken to ink density; the base tier gets the most classic, most neutral ink on the card, which is the plainest possible statement that tier is not rank.

Pro.ink_note: Deep rose. The brand accent (#f472b6, hue ~330) at printable density -- the raw accent measures 2.50:1 on cream and is unusable as ink, which is why position-cards never sets body copy in it either. Same hue, printed.

Premium.ink_note: Brand green, canonical and unmodified from designTokens.brand.green.

Enterprise.ink_note: Tobacco. Outside the token set; justified as the fourth ink needed to complete an equal-weight club set, and it is the warm-neutral counterpart to the cream ground rather than a new brand hue.

patina._comment: The ONLY axis that earns ornament: continuous, unbroken membership time on the current streak (member_since -> now). Tier does not affect this at all -- a Free member who has held since genesis reaches the same patina as a long-held Enterprise member. Ornament is spent as MATERIAL, not decoration: New = ink mon + letterpress bite on plain stock; Established = + milled long edges + ruled intaglio ground; Long-held = + the mark struck in FOIL with a specular crest + full milled edge; Founding = + aged ground + double keyline + deep ruling. Bands are inclusive of min_days, evaluated top-down.

brand._comment: Lifted from packages/design-tokens/src/tokens.ts -> designTokens.brand, which is now the single canonical source for every Suwappu surface (previously this read showcase/tailwind.config.ts, one of two live and disagreeing systems). tests/test_brand_tokens.py re-reads the package and fails if these drift.
